title: Leaks
text: Leaks. Leaked all over in purse

product_metadata.title: Contigo Steel Travel Mug, 24 oz, Stormy Weather
features: Snap seal lid technology is leak proof when closed
Drinks stay hot up to 9 hours or cold up to 21 with thermalock vacuum insulation
Easy one handed drinking with a flip of the lid
Fits most car cup holders for a no hassle commute
Top rack dishwasher safe lid, hand wash only stainless steel body
description: Enjoy a leak proof day with the Contigo SNAPSEAL Byron Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Travel Mug, 24 oz. The lid’s SNAPSEAL technology is designed for an easy one handed drinking experience, even during your morning commute. Pop the top to drink your caffeinated beverage of choice. There’s no lid to unscrew or remove. Just make sure to snap it closed when you’re done sipping to seal the leak proof lid. Thanks to THERMALOCK vacuum insulation, your new all day companion keeps liquids hot up to 9 hours or cold up to 21.
